audit_question.trigger_rationale: This continuation resolves caller-side parameter flow and part of transport ownership. runReplica computes F from configured addresses and forwards master-returned identity, membership and leadership to paxos.New. ConnectToPeers creates peer-specific streams and starts separate listener goroutines, while SendMsg serializes writes through a replica-wide mutex. These observations support investigating cross-peer progress but do not yet establish the proposed schedule. Comparing normal commit broadcast with the full-Commit response to Prepare also exposes a framing dependency: normal broadcast uses commitShortRPC with a Commit object. The next reads target the remaining startup, dispatch and representation prerequisites rather than presuming arbitrary message delivery.
